dedupe_keys.name: rwanda water portal hydrometric data real time river gauges and groundwater levels rwb

description: The Rwanda Water Resources Board publishes hydrometric monitoring data on the Rwanda Water Portal. The real-time surface water page lists 40 telemetered river and lake gauging stations, among them Kinamba, Ruliba on the Nyabarongo, the Akagera outlet, the Kivu outlet at Rusizi I, Ntaruka at Lake Burera and the Sebeya dam, each with all its time series. The real-time groundwater page lists 12 telemetered wells with water level series, shown for the last 24 hours with water level in centimetres. Separate surface water and groundwater pages map station locations with a location list, and the portal also carries publications, water permits and an IWRM geoportal. Coverage is Rwanda, in the upper Nile and Congo basins. Access is free in the browser with no sign-in. Caveats: the pages show charts and tables; no bulk download or licence was found, and the length of the records was not checked. Simulation uses: live river and lake levels for flood warning and hydropower and water supply operation. Related records: RURA water statistics for Rwanda (data-rura-rwanda-water-statistics-quarterly-reports) and the Nepal real-time river watch (data-nepal-flood-forecasting-real-time-river-watch).
